raw_segments.text: It's strange how things happen sometimes. No one had seen her in the street so that
no one knew of it in the town. I lodged with two decrepit old ladies who looked after me.
They were most obliging old things, ready to do anything for me,
and at my request were as silent afterwards as two cast-iron posts.
Of course I grasped the position at once. She walked in and looked straight at me,
her dark eyes determined, even defiant, but on her lips and round her mouth I saw uncertainty.
